name: Healthcare MIS / Diagnostics Booking Pack
description: Industry context for diagnostic lab booking MIS data — bookings, customers, households, lab partners, and health packages.

vocabulary.definition: An order or transaction for a diagnostic test or health package
Group of related customers sharing a household grouping (family bookings)
External lab vendor that fulfilled the booking
Product or service booked (e.g. Full Body Checkup, Diabetes Panel)

canonical_roles.revenue_amount: the monetary amount charged for a completed booking
canonical_roles.transaction_status: the booking lifecycle state (completed / cancelled / pending)
canonical_roles.transaction_date: the date the booking was made
canonical_roles.repeat_flag: whether this booking came from a returning customer
canonical_roles.location: the city/region the booking was made in
canonical_roles.partner_name: the external lab partner fulfilling the booking
canonical_roles.product_name: the health package or test booked

notes: Never expose phone or customer name in aggregate outputs or dashboards
All data access must be read-only
Prefer named KPI tools over ad-hoc SQL when a standard KPI applies
